items.explanation: Naṣara has only its root letters; akrama and taʿallama have letters added.

items.prompt: How many patterns (abwāb) does the bare three-letter verb have in the books?
items.explanation: Naṣara, ḍaraba, fataḥa, samiʿa, karuma and ḥasiba: six patterns.

items.prompt: In which pattern is this verb?
options: i in the past, a in the present
a in the past, u in the present
a in the past, i in the present
u in the past, u in the present
items.explanation: Samiʿa has kasra on the ʿayn in the past and yasmaʿu fatḥa in the present.
